policy.name: Karnataka Industrial Policy 2025-30 (with Operative Guidelines: Package of Incentives and Concessions under IP 2025-30)
policy.order_no: G.O. No. CI/123/SPI/2024(e) dated 08-02-2025; Operative Guidelines approved vide Govt letter CI 123 SPI 2024 dated 10-04-2026

zones.Z1: Zone 1 - industrially most backward taluks (most taluks outside Bengaluru region)
zones.Z2: Zone 2 - relatively developed taluks (e.g. district HQ taluks such as Mysuru, Mangaluru, Tumakuru, Hubballi, Belagavi, Kolar, Malur, Harohalli, Ramanagara)
zones.Z3: Zone 3 - Bengaluru Urban (5 taluks) and Bengaluru Rural (4 taluks); financial incentives in Zone 3 only for Bengaluru Rural district, none for Bengaluru Urban

zone_lookup: Taluk-wise table in Operative Guidelines section 8 'Zonal classification' (pp. 19-23) = Annexure 6 of Industrial Policy 2025-30. Additional top-up for Most/More Backward taluks per Dr. D.M. Nanjundappa Committee: list at Operative Guidelines Annexure 10.29 (p. ~93).

schemes.name: Capital (Investment Promotion) Subsidy - Micro & Small, General category
schemes.clause: Operative Guidelines 11.1 (p.95); Policy doc MSME incentive table
schemes.notes: Basis = Value of Fixed Assets (land, building, P&M incl. utilities, erection, electricals; Guidelines def. 9). Leased premises <20 yrs: P&M only. Zone 3 only Bengaluru Rural. Disbursed in 2 instalments. Apply within 12 months of commercial production; production within 3 yrs of DLSWCC/SLSWCC approval. Expansion: only new investment, at least 25% of existing fixed assets. Only differential if other govt capital subsidy availed. Most backward taluks +5% VFA (max Rs 5 lakh micro / Rs 10 lakh small); more backward +3% (max Rs 3 lakh / Rs 5 lakh).

schemes.name: Capital Subsidy - Micro & Small, Special category (SC/ST, Women, Minorities, Physically Challenged, Ex-Servicemen)
schemes.notes: Special category = unit exclusively owned by the category (all partners/directors). Same conditions and backward-taluk top-ups as general category.
conditions: Unit wholly owned by special-category entrepreneurs as defined in the policy

schemes.name: Base Subsidy option A - Capital Subsidy for Medium enterprises
schemes.notes: Mutually exclusive with PLI option (11.2.2: 2.5%/2.0%/1.0% of net sales turnover for 7 yrs capped at 60%/60%/30% of VFA) - choice fixed when filing. Disbursed in 4 equal annual instalments. Most backward taluk +5% VFA (max Rs 50 lakh), more backward +3% (max Rs 25 lakh). Incentives only for new investments for medium (term q.vi). Guidelines' MSME definition still quotes old thresholds (medium P&M <= Rs 50 cr) but clause (o)/(p) says classification follows MSMED Act as revised.
conditions: Chosen instead of the turnover-linked (PLI) option

schemes.name: Exemption from Tax on Electricity Tariff (electricity duty) for MSMEs
schemes.notes: Special category: Z1 8 yrs, Z2 7 yrs, Z3 4 yrs. 100% exemption. Guidelines note: no certificate to be issued under IP 2025-30 until Energy Department issues concurrence notification (term e) - check status before claiming.
conditions: Applies once the Energy Department notifies the exemption

schemes.name: Power Subsidy for Micro & Small Enterprises
schemes.notes: Reimbursement of Rs 1.00 per unit consumed for 3 years, Zones 1 and 2 only (all entrepreneur categories); Zone 3 nil. Claims half-yearly (June/December).

schemes.name: Quality Certification incentive (ISO, BIS, FSSAI-AGMARK, ECOMARK, ZED, ISI, FPO, BEE, other)
schemes.clause: Industrial Policy 2025-30 'Quality Certification' table (p.48); Operative Guidelines section 13 (p.144-)
schemes.notes: 50% of cost of application, total cap Rs 5,00,000 per entity (across certifications). One-time per certification type; claim within certificate validity; administered by MD, KCTU. Export certifications (CE, CCC, GMP, HACCP, SEDEX etc.) carry the same 50% / Rs 5 lakh per entity terms (Guidelines section 15).

schemes.name: Sustainability-linked incentive for MSMEs (ETP/ZLD/APC/energy efficiency equipment)
schemes.notes: 50% of equipment cost up to Rs 50 lakh each for ETP/CETP/waste mgmt, ZLD, air pollution control, electrification of low-temp thermal processes/Li-ion BESS; energy efficiency 50% of certification cost up to Rs 50 lakh; EV conversion of vehicles 10% up to Rs 10 lakh. Overall capped at 10% of VFA. These costs excluded from VFA for base subsidy.

other_benefits: Stamp duty: 100% exemption (Zones 1-2; Zone 3 nil, special category 75%) on loan and land deeds; concessional registration Rs 1 per Rs 1000 (Guidelines 11.3/11.4). Currently granted as per IP 2020-25 / reimbursement until Karnataka Stamp Act amended.
Land conversion fee: 100% reimbursement after commercial production in Zones 1-2 (Zone 3 nil; special category 75%) (Guidelines 11.5).
Medium enterprise PLI option: 2.5%/2.0%/1.0% of net sales turnover (Z1/Z2/Z3-Bengaluru Rural) for 7 years, capped at 60%/60%/30% of VFA (Guidelines 11.2.2).
Export certification support: 50% of cost, cap Rs 5 lakh per entity (Guidelines 15).
unverifiable: No interest subsidy and no SGST reimbursement for MSMEs found in IP 2025-30 or its operative guidelines.

Electricity tax exemption and stamp duty exemption under IP 2025-30 depend on Energy/Revenue Department notifications; guidelines (Apr 2026) say not yet issued - could not confirm issuance by 17-Oct-2026.
